name: 40 Minutes to Eternity
source:
Love and loss. Tormented by his abusive father, Aidan finds solace in reading, getting lost in other worlds, weaved by so many before him who could not fit inside this reality. There he meets someone, someone like him. Reality, however, will not stand idly by.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/40-minutes-to-eternity.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
爱与失去。艾丹饱受虐待他的父亲折磨，只能通过阅读寻求慰藉，沉浸在那些由无数无法融入现实的人编织出的另一个世界。在那里，他遇见了一个和自己相似的人。然而，现实不会坐视不管。

[来自[url=http://renai.us/game/40-minutes-to-eternity.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
